name: Parallel Percent
source:
When an artificial intelligence finds itself encased in flesh, a struggle to save its host reveals a world long devoid of hope.

“The worst part is the silence. I can still hear your screams.”

You have awoken encased in flesh, your systems long-defunct and inoperable. In your slumber, your world has come to an end, and the only weapon left in your arsenal is your host: a young woman named Claire.

[From the [url=https://rk5.ca/HIVE]official website[/url]]
